services.analysis: The request includes supplies and works, which are outside the scope of the mandate. The mandate is limited to service contracts only, with CPV divisions between 50 and 98. Therefore, the request must be declined as it violates the boundary constraints.

works.analysis: The request includes supplies and services, which are outside the scope of my mandate. I can only handle construction works under the CPV division 45, below the EU works threshold, and with competitive procedures. I cannot plan procurement for supplies or services.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: For the €10 million annual procurement budget, the recommendation is to allocate 30% (€3 million) to supplies. The services and works specialists have declined to provide allocations as the request included components outside their mandate. The supplies will be divided into lots focusing on sustainability criteria. The award criterion for supplies will be best price-quality ratio with weights of 60% for price and 40% for quality. However, due to the constraints flagged by the services and works specialists, the remaining 70% of the budget (€7 million) is currently unallocated and will be reviewed with the principal for further direction.
